title: Costco Wholesale, FY2023 vs FY2022

attempts.text: Costco Wholesale Corporation reported a 6.8% increase in revenue from $227.0bn in FY2022 to $242.3bn in FY2023. The company's operating cash flow increased by 49.7% to $11.07bn, while its capital expenditure increased by $43bn to $4.32bn. The largest movers in FY2023 were operating cash flow and capital expenditure, with operating cash flow increasing by 49.7% and capital expenditure increasing by $43bn.

final_text: Costco revenue was $242.3bn in FY2023, up 6.8% from $227.0bn in FY2022. Operating margin was 3.35% (down 0.08 pp), with SG&A at 8.91% of revenue. The largest movements were: Operating cash flow increased by $3.68bn; Capital expenditure increased by $0.43bn; SG&A increased by $1.81bn.
